

# Bibliothèques

```{r}

library(bnlearn)
library(data.table)
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)

library(visNetwork)
library(igraph)

```



# Chargement des données

```{r}


# labels
path <- 'datas'
latent.path <- "datas/latent_test.csv"
labels.path <- "datas/Morpho_test - discrete - 5_5_5_5_5_10.csv"

# latents
path <- 'DATAS/MNIST'
latent <- fread(latent.path, data.table = F, sep = ",", header = TRUE, index = FALSE)
data_disc <- fread(labels.path, data.table = F, sep = ",", header = TRUE, index = FALSE)


latent
data_disc

```


# Datas <- concat(latents, labels) 

```{r}

c(names(latent), names(data_disc))

data <- cbind(latent, data_disc)
names(data) <- c(names(latent), names(data_disc))
data[, names(data_disc)] <- lapply(data[, names(data_disc)], as.factor)


head(data)

```


# Exclusion des relations continu → discret

```{r}

disc <- names(data)[sapply(data, is.factor)]
cont <- names(data)[sapply(data, is.numeric)]

blacklist <- expand.grid(from = cont, to = disc)

```



# Graphe par Bootstrap

```{r}

start.time <- Sys.time()

set.seed(42)

boot <- boot.strength(
  data = data,
  R = 500,
  algorithm = "hc",
  algorithm.args = list(score = "bic-cg", blacklist = blacklist)
)

end.time <- Sys.time()
end.time -start.time

```
Time difference of 21.19556 mins -> 27 variables - 50 boots
Time difference of 26 mins -> 29 variables - 50 boots
Time difference of 44 mins -> 38 variables - 50 boots


```{r}

DAG.path <- "datas/DAG.csv"
write.csv(boot, DAG.path)


```




```{r}

th <- bnlearn:::threshold(boot)
th

boot.kept <- boot[(boot$strength >= th) & (boot$direction >= 0.5), ]
boot.kept

```


th <- bnlearn:::threshold(arcs)
# Tu selectionnes les arcs
arcs[(arcs$strength >= th) & (arcs$direction >= 0.5), ]



arcs <- arcs(bn)

bad <- arcs[
  arcs[, "from"] %in% cont &
  arcs[, "to"]   %in% disc,
]

bad

```{r}

relations_principales <- boot[
  boot$strength > 0.8 & boot$direction > 0.6,
]
relations_principales

```



```{r}

avg_net <- averaged.network(boot, threshold = 0.95)
graphviz.plot(avg_net)

```



```{r}

library(Rgraphviz)
graphviz.plot(avg_net, highlight = list(arcs = subset(boot, strength > 0.99)[,1:2]))

```
